tasks.title: E28 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E28 (Onboard plans: no dead ends). Implement it in full from its design docs/tdd/E28.md: every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E28/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E28/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).

ticket_tasks.title: Pure plan rules and exhaustive action guards
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md first, in that order, then every reads entry. Implement only owned_paths. This brief is self-contained: do not assume another session's context. Recheck the actual tree and all docs/build/*/tasks.json before creating anything. At planning time hub/, ui/, eval/, generated contracts and non-pharmacy runtime config were absent. Never overwrite another task's work, create a provider implementation or edit a shared toolchain/design/request/log file. New tests stay in your owned test subtree, which partitions E28 section 13's hub/tests/plans/** allocation. Runtime files expand the exact section 13 brace lists. All sample data belongs in fixtures/ or eval/ under an explicit profile, never production fallback. Configuration and API content supply words/values; tests edit scratch documents only, never shipped safety mappings.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory/require_id; 5.2 Clock/TimeInput/ClockCorrections; 5.3 MissionClock; 5.4 Quantity/Unit; 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and ErrorEnvelope; 5.6 ConfigReleaseReader.active/release, ReleaseHandle.document/version_of, ReleaseCheck/ActivationGuard; 5.7 UnitOfWork/ReadSnapshot and factories, events, audiences and subscriber cursors; 5.8 command identity, IdempotencyStore, ResultVisibility, CommandIntents and CommandResumer; 5.9 AuditEntry; 5.10 scheduler/health; 5.11 typed HubSettings/SettingSpec; 5.12 ModuleRegistry. Do not define substitutes for them. Use uv --project hub and pnpm from SYSTEM 6; import only other modules' application.ports, never their domain/adapters. SYSTEM 8.1/8.2/8.3/8.4/8.5/8.6 settle escalation, guidance, privacy, authority, active location and durability. SYSTEM 9/10 supplies hard dependencies and kernel.testing. Until a provider is built use its published Protocol with the delivered kernel fakes in unit tests only. A missing signature/DTO/fake is a prerequisite, never permission for a local copy. Integration acceptance uses the real hub, not test overrides inside it.

Binding deviations from the frozen design: use ReleaseHandle and typed settings instead of ReleaseRef/document_bytes/HubSettings.get. No direct config.domain or guidance imports in plans.domain. Call GuidanceEligibility in application and map its immutable decision into pure input. Plans never imports groundlink: catchup supplies ground presentation through the still-pending shared seam. D9 denies station clinical runs/writes; officer, help membership or assigned helper status never grants a full chart. All reads, writes, errors, events, replay and tools enforce current object/field grants; a full PlanRun event requires every field to be authorized. Q1/Q7/Q18 keep not-clinically-reviewed visible without waiting on sign-off; source/purpose/hash/origin/applicability/operator gates remain. SYSTEM 8.1 replaces unkeyed HelpEntryPort with PlanHelpEntry and durable escalation intents. Guided disagreement retains real manual/camera observations and never completes a step. Storage/I/O/integrity/auth/config faults escape all isolation; only known semantic refusals can be handled without applying the plan effect. D6 late replay uses the durable accepted_command receipt, never re-execution or a local ledger. Preserve all 20 review fixes, with the explicit overrides above.

Requests P28-1 through P28-11 in PLAN.md are coordinator handoffs, not accepted contracts. docs/requests/E28.md did not exist at inspection; only the coordinator may create it under the current edit restriction. Read it if the coordinator supplies it, and verify acceptance/provider publication before using a requested seam. Return exact missing dependencies/findings to the coordinator without editing outside owned_paths. In particular P28-1 blocks unowned module.py/manifests/migration relocation; P28-2 blocks missing toolchain/fakes/fixture/safety gates; P28-3 blocks the undeclared bounded port executor; P28-5 blocks incomplete text/source validation. Do not widen ownership to finish registration. No em/en dashes or spaced hyphen dash in authored output. Source quotations follow Q26's explicit verbatim exception.

Write the assigned tests first with their T28 ID and R/V/D/invariant trace. Property-test parsers/rules and use independently checked golden expected outcomes, not expected medical answers derived from the same config as input. Bound all iterations/pages/history/caches/external calls with published settings. Run every gate; missing prerequisites, zero collected scenarios, skip/xfail acceptance or missing positive path is not done. A done task has green owned gates, no unresolved enabled safety defect and evidence for every assigned trace. Epic done additionally requires the full suites, CI, independent review and coordinator-recorded AI-use rows. A failing gate is reported/fixed by its owner, never weakened. No product code is authorized outside the listed paths.

Build only the pure E28 domain in design sections 3.1 to 3.6, the pure portions of 8.2 and the rejection rules of 4.6. Files are named in docs/tdd/E28.md:881. T2 authors content, T3 performs I/O/validation calls/transactions/API, T4 renders, T5 owns real-stack acceptance. Leave no module registration or configuration I/O in __init__.py. SYSTEM 4.1/6.4 controls layers. Do not import E32's domain to share its types: local pure SupplyNeed/StockLevel map through the owner's application DTOs, retaining Quantity and unit identity. E32 3.2 and E28 3.1/3.2 give the exact field lists. No formula call crosses from domain to supplies.application; cover_after is immutable precomputed input.

Implement PlanStageId, PlanMode, Cadence, Who, SupplyNeed, Needs, Recheck, Step, Plan, Person, StockLevel, EnvContext, Availability, RunState, StepState, RunStep, PlanRun, ActionContext, RunEffects and the exact apply/assess_step/runnable_now/plan_aboard/waits_for_medical_officer/return_applies mechanisms from E28 3.1 to 3.5. Use immutable typed records/tuples. Do not expose these as hand-written wire models. PlanRunCreate/PlanRunAction/PlanView/PlanRun on the boundary are generated models owned by E01. E28 3.1 omits some structures: copy their shape from config-onboard-plans/plan-view/plan-run schema before implementing ReturnStage/GroundLogStage and other fields, never infer them. Internal fields absent from wire remain internal. Carry nullable quantities/null due times and all LIVE/REPLAY/SIM origins exactly.

Apply the full ordered public action matrix in E28 3.5. Guard closed runs, membership, stale revisions, substitute actionability, own availability, nonempty who_can and validated eligibility/references. StepDone never marks an unavailable principal or auto-completes its substitute. UseSubstitute makes the substitute open/actionable; a separate completion checks its own skills/operator/resources/evidence. The recorder may differ from the eligible performer, but an unavailable/incapacitated subject is never inferred eligible. Recheck a done watch step only when If-Match is not older than recorded_revision, with its own occurrence/debit and bounds. Exactly one revision/event effect per visible change, none for a merged no-op. State derives from active steps/escalations/close, never ground receipt/reply/link. PR-I2 is XOR episode/help parent; PR-I3 preserves step order/pins. For internal completion only checked agree/no_reference may produce effects; disagree is no completion. EscalationClosed/HandoffLinked record allowed late bookkeeping. Historical escalation reconciliation on a changed/closed run follows SYSTEM 8.1 rather than the old closed-run no-op; T3 supplies the validated intent/receipt and never rewinds a step.

Availability follows CONTRACTS 22 ordered rules and SYSTEM 8.2 facts mapped by T3. Missing source/purpose/hash/origin/environment, unknown resources and no eligible awake/on-site/non-EVA operator cannot enable execution. plan_aboard remains kit/stock-only planning, while runnable_now is subject-specific. Skill/officer excludes subject, any_crew includes subject only when otherwise available. Missing supply/unit mismatch never means aboard; retain typed mismatch for the action to fail loudly. Return prepare applies only under the active environment's nonnull return_option. Recheck intervals/cadences use externally normalized anchors/durations, calendar.month_days from routine-rules, and SYSTEM mission-time rendering supplied by T3. No wall-clock reads or a new scheduler.

release_checks.py implements pure check 14a to 14h and 15 calculations over validated inputs, not a ReleaseCheck adapter with I/O. Candidate/source/text/RTDC checks are injected results through the approved application binding. No incomplete 14e path: reject unavailable text validation. Validate filtered non-rejected plans/steps before dangling substitute/row checks, fixed stage order, nonblocking last ground stage, same-plan substitute-only targets/no cycles, operator/stage/guided constraints, units, recheck shape and configured bounds. Check 15's documented LIVE rejection versus SIM/REPLAY finding must preserve its row/environment details. T3 owns orchestration/registration and calls providers; no config.domain import here. Tool rules produce the ordered rejection reasons in E28 4.6 and never mutate a run or safety state.

Tests first in hub/tests/plans/domain/: T28-10 every matrix cell/public/internal event/revision, T28-11 stateful sequences (R47, EI5, PR-I1/2/4), T28-18 pure full-field scan decisions (EI6/R56), T28-20/21/22/23 table/property availability/stages/holders (EI3/4/7,R57,V82), T28-28 Quantity/import direction, T28-39 deterministic view/columns, and pure T28-02/03/07/08/14/17 cases. Independently assert correct expected outcomes for ICL10/eye/daily examples, null/zero/negative/max, incompatible units, missing stock/holder, officer as patient, only holder asleep/EVA, substitute already done/guided, rejected content and changed environment. Unit tests use production parsers/rules after generated validation, never hardcoded clinical content. Configuration-edit proof changes a scratch step label and a nonsafety requirement and observes the new pure view; no mapping edit. Storage/crash/outage/privacy HTTP cases belong to T3/T5, not fake storage tests here.

Done means all pure tests/gates pass, no domain cross-layer import, complete decision conditions and no missing safety case. T5 must later verify >=95% branch for each domain file, full condition coverage, complexity <=15 and critical mutation behavior under P28-2. Do not claim this solely from aggregate coverage. Missing kernel or shared text semantics blocks the affected tests, never relaxes validation.
gates: uv run --project hub pytest -c hub/pyproject.toml -q hub/tests/plans/domain
uv run --project hub ruff check hub/src/crew_health/plans/__init__.py hub/src/crew_health/plans/domain hub/tests/plans/domain
uv run --project hub ruff format --check hub/src/crew_health/plans/__init__.py hub/src/crew_health/plans/domain hub/tests/plans/domain
uv run --project hub mypy --strict hub/src/crew_health/plans/__init__.py hub/src/crew_health/plans/domain

e28_t1_imports=$(mktemp)
uv run --project hub python -m crew_health.app.import_contracts --output "$e28_t1_imports" && uv run --project hub lint-imports --config "$e28_t1_imports"

Tests stay in hub/tests/plans/authoring/. Do not edit kit-map, E10 source registry, skills, UI words or E33 files. E27 authors ground_needs/treatment_scope/rtdc/form values; E28 verifies them and authors plans. T1 supplies pure checks; T3 supplies production configuration activation; T5 tests those through HTTP. No hub service/endpoint/table is built in this task.

Read package research first, including saved form/source artifacts referenced by NASA-SOURCES and condition rows. The NASA form is authoritative for quoted ground needs/RTDC, not a general non-doctor treatment procedure. Follow Q26 source hashes/pages and Q24 serialized source acquisition only if separately authorized; no bulk fetch. Use local package sources/registered E10 access, no network dependency in tests. Unsupported source/row/check remains an explicit finding and E28-03 is not done. Never substitute a generic example for missing production content.

Write the seven demo condition plans for ICL10, ICL3, ICL14, ICL95, ICL18, ICL64 and ICL100, twenty flow plans enumerated from responder-flows, and family-derived plans for every remaining one of the 119 rows, per product E28-02/03 and design 8.3. Do not assume the eight-plan example is the full production release or flip example to false as a shortcut. Preserve sourced steps/needs/who/basis and source_ids with not-clinically-reviewed notice and real provenance. Different models draft and check each written plan/template, and a different checker validates every expanded row. Request the coordinator's independent checker; never fill checked_by/result from intention or your own self-review. Clinical sign-off is not a runtime gate, but actual source checks remain mandatory. Model identity is provenance, never an invented clinical credential.

Build is deterministic: E28 5.3 defines plan_ + lowercase(condition_id), rewritten step/substitute keys and replaces_ground_task equal to the matching true ground_need quote/source/page. Every flow/condition has the schema-required scope, stages/order, reference existence and review fields. ground_log is last/nonblocking and no step waits for ground. No clinical amount in text, no synthetic interval, and medicine wording uses the sourced onboard-procedure phrase with the schema's names-only medicine object. Q14 permits E32's trusted dose workflow; this task never computes a dose or extends the plan schema. RTDC remains null without verified source/second check. Accept E33 return-stage proposals through E28 only, using its published RtdcVerificationPort.verify after P28-8; do not implement an RTDC parser here or import readiness domain. No request is an accepted new CSV/contract.

check.py receives config/onboard-plans.json and config/kit-map.json as E28 15 specifies. Verify byte equality to build output, generated schema validity/provenance/reference/size rules and T1 pure checks. Through the approved production check binding, require all loader checks 14/15, full 14e and form/RTDC verification before declaring the release ready. T3's adapter integration is final T5 evidence; do not copy its loader. Check exact row coverage and plan kind, actual assignments with writer != checker, row_checks with checker != plan writer and result ok, nonnull required source/page form values or permitted source-proven no-table RTDC, every true ground_need replaced by the exact quote, no dangling substitutes after filtering rejected content. Missing E27 full rows/sources or text/verifier binding is a nonzero gate, not a warning or filled default. P28-9 consolidates R28-11/17/R27-4; E28-03 remains blocked until it lands.

Tests first: T28-40 property/determinism/ID/substitute/quote expansion (E28-03), T28-41 rejects missing row/check/source/page/true-ground-task/false full-coverage report (R47/R57,V82,D32), and T28-18/20 content inputs (R56,EI3/6). Golden rows are independently checked against their form/source, not tests deriving expected medicine behavior from the generated document. Use scratch copies for label changes: regenerate/check, show different emitted content with unchanged build code. Repeat build with reordered filesystem inputs, missing/corrupt source, duplicate ID, maximum-size input and null fields; deterministic bounded failure with no partially replaced output. Clinical text remains authored data, not inline test fixtures. Coordinate independent per-row/model checks as evidence, not a new authoring framework.

Done requires all 119 rows and 20 flows, real independent checks and exact existing check.py CLI gate, with all gates green. Missing E27 form/source values, rejected checks or absent independent model evidence is reported as blocked content delivery; never weaken counts/review rules to pass. This task can run beside T3 after T1; it does not wait for the whole optional E10/E33 implementation to author already sourced material.
gates: uv run --project hub pytest -c hub/pyproject.toml -q hub/tests/plans/authoring
uv run --project hub ruff check authoring/plans hub/tests/plans/authoring
uv run --project hub ruff format --check authoring/plans hub/tests/plans/authoring
uv run --project hub mypy --strict authoring/plans

Implement E28 2, 4.1 to 4.7, 5.1/5.2/5.4, 6, 8.1/8.2, 9 to 11 in the exact owned application/adapters/api/cli files from section 13. T1 owns pure rules; T2 owns authored content; T4 owns client controls; T5 owns real-stack eval. Do not create module.py, settings.py, replica.schema.json, architecture.toml or relocated migration files: P28-1 must reconcile ownership/registration with SYSTEM 4.1/5.12. Supply precise registration requirements to the coordinator. No central app/tool/CLI file edits or import-time self-registration workaround. Once authorized via a revised allocation, registration is a separate coordinator assignment, not silently included here.

Boundary names copied from docs/product/api/openapi.yaml: GET /v1/conditions/{condition_id}/plan getConditionPlan; GET /v1/plans/{plan_id} getPlan; GET/POST /v1/plan-runs listPlanRuns/startPlanRun; GET /v1/plan-runs/{plan_run_id} getPlanRun; POST /v1/plan-runs/{plan_run_id}/actions actOnPlanRun. Parse generated PlanRunCreate/PlanRunAction; map generated PlanView/PlanRun/events/ErrorEnvelope, respecting closed shapes and nullability. Enforce parent XOR and subject identity. Public content can serve allowed x-roles; clinical run operations require an authenticated person and current object/field grant. Station is UNAUTHORIZED_SCOPE, never an emergency fallback clinical recorder. Non-person actors cannot act. Subject can read own; accepted task access exposes only that task, never full PlanRun; officer/acting status alone grants none. Use E02's actual published consent/visibility interface after delivery, not a guessed allows signature. Filter list pagination before revealing IDs/counts. Until R28-1 exists, PlanView subject is own-person for crew and None for planning; no cross-subject runnable controls.

Header/error rules are E28 6.1 plus D5/D6/SYSTEM 5.5/5.8. Config-Release mismatch on start/action is 409 CONFIG_VERSION_MISMATCH; If-Match missing is 428 VERSION_REQUIRED, stale commuting actions merge only by the pure matrix, stale escalate/close fail. Return ETag revision, Config-Release and X-Correlation-Id. getPlan outside its environment returns 200 ground_log-only; unknown/rejected plan 404, getConditionPlan missing/rejected/out-of-environment plan 422 CONTEXT_INAPPLICABLE. Unit mismatch fails action loudly, no write; below-zero supply 422 SUPPLY_BELOW_ZERO rolls back all effects. Forbidden error current_state cannot disclose a run/step to an unauthorized requester. Duplicate start is bounded/indexed and returns only currently authorized current_state. Omit optional action Config-Release from T4 client rather than ignoring it server-side.

Consume exact owner application ports: E02 RosterPort; E23 MissionStatePort/OverlayPort/EnvironmentProfileReader/DayLabelPort; E27 KitQueryPort/KitMapReleaseSource, GuidanceEligibility/GuidanceRequest/GuidanceDecision, KitMapContext/ReleasePins/PlanColumnsPort/PlanningDelta/PlanChange; E32 StockReader/SupplyLedgerPort/with_added and the requested SupplyCoverPort. E28 4.1/4.2 gives legacy field shapes, but SYSTEM and the actual providers win. E31's current section 2 fixes SkillHolderPort.holders, RoleEnginePort.propose_for_plan_step and RoleQueryPort.plan_run_person_ids. E15 EpisodeReader.visible and E26 HelpSessionReader.context/readable_by govern parent visibility. E01 ObservationRefReader.get_many and E30 GuidedCheckReader.get need P28-8/R-E01-17 caller snapshot/auth/partition and plural observation fields. Import a protocol only after its owner publishes it; do not define copies or invent DTOs. Context/origin/stock/eligibility/reference reads share caller UoW/read snapshot and run pins; a self-opening legacy reader cannot authorize an action. P28-3 must supply bounded port execution. Unknown stock/people/operator facts never enable execution. No optional provider becomes a production fake or sample fallback.

Provide E28 4.2 PlanQueries (state, return_candidates/catch_up_inputs only where counterparts agree), PlanRunReaderService.guided_step/context, PlanColumnsService.row_columns/plans_changed and GapPlanPort.plan_for through the published provider/consumer protocols. Respect SYSTEM 4.2 names PlanQueries/PlanRunReader/PlanAvailability. The design's E33 X6 citation is wrong: E33 section 4.1 actually requests PlanRunQueryPort.return_runs and RtdcVerificationPort.verify. P28-8 must publish the agreed history/return DTO and SYSTEM snapshot mapping before that bridge; no parallel invented history API. PlanRunReader.context uses the active environment and pinned SupplyNeed Quantity values under current visibility. guided_step supplies run pins, subject, active environment and actual step_open/runnable state. For plan_columns use E27 4.1's exact signatures: ctx contains snapshot, release, stock, usable_now and at. Overlay instruments with union, supplies with E32 with_added(ctx.stock, delta.add_supplies), skills as practiced-now in that same snapshot. Preserve document order and no writes/events. Never recompute cover or hypothetical stock with a local E32 formula.

Storage uses SYSTEM StorageSession, STRICT/FK/additive migration and E01 UoW, not sqlite3/manual BEGIN/commits in application. The owned old migration path must be discoverable through the coordinator's approved resolution. Tables from E28 5.1: plans_run, plans_run_pin, plans_run_step, plans_run_step_observation, plans_run_step_supply_use, plans_run_recheck, plans_run_recheck_entry, plans_run_escalation, plans_parsed_plan, plans_ground_snapshot. Preserve exact nullable fields, origin enum and indexes/XOR/closed checks. Decimal quantities persist as canonical text plus UCUM, never REAL. Never read another module's tables. P28-1 must publish how durable pre-help intent/occurrence/time provenance is stored; existing escalation PK alone cannot hold that pending intent. Do not guess an extra table. No ground snapshot is exposed before the accepted E16 approval/delivery/grant interface; until R28-5/24 getPlanRun ground is 403 CONSENT_REQUIRED.

startPlanRun pins onboard-plans, skills-catalog, role-rules, kit-map, ui-copy and opening release/environment/origin, inserts every applicable step open and commits run/audit/outbox/identity/replication together. After commit role proposals are optional and recover through durable plan events. actOnPlanRun reads immutable pinned plan but current environment/custody/people/stock. E32's debit is in the same UoW and binds occurrence/pinned_release_id/run/step/supply exactly once. Until E32's occurrence seam lands refuse supply-consuming rechecks as E28 R28-20 says; T5 cannot call repeated-use acceptance done under that interim. Validate every observation's existence, grant, subject, episode, origin, quality, count and uniqueness, and every check's run/skill/subject/origin/checked outcome before applying. Manual completion records no invented guided evidence. Reject unsupported references rather than accepting unvalidated IDs while ports are missing.

Escalation uses SYSTEM 8.1 exactly: pure guards/current access first; short durable parent CommandIntents reservation assigning stable occurrence, escalation_id, expected revision and TimeInput before intermodule effects; E26 PlanHelpEntry.open_from_plan_step(PlanEscalation) in its own transaction and child internal.plan_help_entry identity; final E28 UoW records HelpEscalationReceipt and completes the parent. E28 late-binds PlanEscalationReader for E26. After crash use receipt/escalation_id and shared CommandResumer/scheduler, not public entry.ref_id matching. Joined help retains its old pin/flow, and closed old occurrence never reopens. Changed/closed run receives historical reconciliation/notice without rewinding steps or acknowledging an unfinished parent. All persistence failures propagate, preserving immediate cached human help but returning no accepted parent receipt. Max escalation limit cannot silently lose an already committed help receipt; resolve exact admission/reconciliation schema under P28-1/P28-3.

GuidedCheckCompleted is handled inside E30's UoW per SYSTEM 8.1. Validate current subject-specific guidance/reference facts; agree/no_reference only can apply once. disagree leaves step incomplete with no successful event/debit and retains manual/camera records at E30/E01. Expected semantic refusal can roll back E28 work via E01 savepoint and leave E30's capture committed; storage/I/O/integrity/auth/config errors propagate and abort, never catch-all 'logged'. Durable subscribers use E01 cursor/effects transactions for help.session_changed, handoff.changed and config.release_activated. Match handoff.plan_run_id, never episode. Events contain full generated PlanRun with allowed_actions=[], one per changed revision, pinned release/time and plans.run_viewers Audience. Full-field admission required under D9; do not send close.note or referenced IDs to partial-grant helpers. Partial wire events are invalid, so suppress and refetch authorized projections. Restrict missing/corrupt/rejected pinned-plan runs to help/close, keep accepted history and loud reference-only faults.

config_source wraps T1 pure checks with SYSTEM ReleaseCheck/ActivationGuard. Pure check(candidate) never writes plans_parsed_plan. Validate all generated schemas and complete 14e/14f/check15 before transactional cache publication at activation/startup; build parsed rows/hash-pinned units ahead of serving, bounded LRU per E28 11, no whole-document parse on request. Resolve E01 TextRulesPort under P28-5/R-E01-27; no direct config.domain import and no missing-validator partial mode. PlansReleaseCheck never ignores a thrown storage/config error. Check 15 failure mode is the documented LIVE rejection versus SIM/REPLAY gap finding, not permission to downgrade another failure. Read config/onboard-plans.json, kit-map.json, skills-catalog.json, role-rules.json, environment-profiles.json, responder-flows.json, routine-rules.json and ui-copy.json only through validated release handles. Rechecks retain correction provenance: elapsed intervals shift with corrections, contact instants do not; missing/unknown time stays pending, labels use mission HH:MM including a nonmidnight epoch. Settings in E28 11 register through P28-1/P28-3; never use contradictory timeout values or station clinical polling.

Tool adapters implement get_plan/choose_plan_step/explain_step from E28 4.6 through E12's accepted binding, never import crew_health.tools/assistant into plans. E12 section 2 ToolHandler.handle(uow, scope, arguments, deadline) -> HandlerOutcome is a proposed boundary, R-E12-12/P28-10 must settle consumer-owned binding; do not duck-type a gateway. Reject ordered reasons plan_not_active, step_not_in_plan, step_substitute_only, step_not_runnable, answer_out_of_scope, dose_in_text; source every displayed string from config/E10 purpose-eligible evidence. Tool proposals never start/mark/escalate/close/reorder/choose helpers or mutate warning/urgency. Dose-bearing prose must also hit E12 output policy, not just ID-string scanning. No model is needed for deterministic tool rules. Ground log helper consumes accepted catchup presentation only (P28-4). E29 has no readable design at final verification; require its published catchup protocol before integration. cli.py implements the E28 5.4 command crew-health plans print-cards --environment <id> --out <dir> using the approved E20 extension/E01 disk release-store reader, no database/hub dependency. Static HTML includes stages/text/needs/substitutes/notice/version/packed basis with print stylesheet; no second template language/framework.

Tests first in hub/tests/plans/runtime/: T28-01 to 09,12 to 17,24 to 30,32,42,43, including counterpart tests as actual providers land. Trace R47/R50/R56/R57/R58/R59/R61, EI1 to EI8/EI11/EI12, PR-I1 to PR-I9 and V81/82/83/84/94/95. Unit port fakes must conform to provider protocols; T5 owns acceptance with real services. Test crash before/after intent/help/final commits, joined-flow/closed-run races, duplicate events, same key/different body/target/parameters and >24h receipts, concurrent start/last-use/recheck, disk full/I/O during audit/outbox/cursor writes, missing/corrupt active/pinned configuration, forward/backward/unknown time, mission epoch 13:37Z, max observations/rechecks/escalations and long ground outage/backlog. Test absent/incapacitated patient and absent providers without blocking fixed help, manual path and close; retain conflicting real records without averaging. Test current object/field auth on HTTP/events/errors/tools/replay and later revocation. ticket_tasks.title: Configured Assessment and pinned plan UI with browser fallbacks
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md first, in that order, then every reads entry. Implement only owned_paths. This brief is self-contained: do not assume another session's context. Recheck the actual tree and all docs/build/*/tasks.json before creating anything. At planning time hub/, ui/, eval/, generated contracts and non-pharmacy runtime config were absent. Never overwrite another task's work, create a provider implementation or edit a shared toolchain/design/request/log file. New tests stay in your owned test subtree, which partitions E28 section 13's hub/tests/plans/** allocation. Runtime files expand the exact section 13 brace lists. All sample data belongs in fixtures/ or eval/ under an explicit profile, never production fallback. Configuration and API content supply words/values; tests edit scratch documents only, never shipped safety mappings.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory/require_id; 5.2 Clock/TimeInput/ClockCorrections; 5.3 MissionClock; 5.4 Quantity/Unit; 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and ErrorEnvelope; 5.6 ConfigReleaseReader.active/release, ReleaseHandle.document/version_of, ReleaseCheck/ActivationGuard; 5.7 UnitOfWork/ReadSnapshot and factories, events, audiences and subscriber cursors; 5.8 command identity, IdempotencyStore, ResultVisibility, CommandIntents and CommandResumer; 5.9 AuditEntry; 5.10 scheduler/health; 5.11 typed HubSettings/SettingSpec; 5.12 ModuleRegistry. Do not define substitutes for them. Use uv --project hub and pnpm from SYSTEM 6; import only other modules' application.ports, never their domain/adapters. SYSTEM 8.1/8.2/8.3/8.4/8.5/8.6 settle escalation, guidance, privacy, authority, active location and durability. SYSTEM 9/10 supplies hard dependencies and kernel.testing. Until a provider is built use its published Protocol with the delivered kernel fakes in unit tests only. A missing signature/DTO/fake is a prerequisite, never permission for a local copy. Integration acceptance uses the real hub, not test overrides inside it.

Binding deviations from the frozen design: use ReleaseHandle and typed settings instead of ReleaseRef/document_bytes/HubSettings.get. No direct config.domain or guidance imports in plans.domain. Call GuidanceEligibility in application and map its immutable decision into pure input. Plans never imports groundlink: catchup supplies ground presentation through the still-pending shared seam. D9 denies station clinical runs/writes; officer, help membership or assigned helper status never grants a full chart. All reads, writes, errors, events, replay and tools enforce current object/field grants; a full PlanRun event requires every field to be authorized. Q1/Q7/Q18 keep not-clinically-reviewed visible without waiting on sign-off; source/purpose/hash/origin/applicability/operator gates remain. SYSTEM 8.1 replaces unkeyed HelpEntryPort with PlanHelpEntry and durable escalation intents. Guided disagreement retains real manual/camera observations and never completes a step. Storage/I/O/integrity/auth/config faults escape all isolation; only known semantic refusals can be handled without applying the plan effect. D6 late replay uses the durable accepted_command receipt, never re-execution or a local ledger. Preserve all 20 review fixes, with the explicit overrides above.

Requests P28-1 through P28-11 in PLAN.md are coordinator handoffs, not accepted contracts. docs/requests/E28.md did not exist at inspection; only the coordinator may create it under the current edit restriction. Read it if the coordinator supplies it, and verify acceptance/provider publication before using a requested seam. Return exact missing dependencies/findings to the coordinator without editing outside owned_paths. In particular P28-1 blocks unowned module.py/manifests/migration relocation; P28-2 blocks missing toolchain/fakes/fixture/safety gates; P28-3 blocks the undeclared bounded port executor; P28-5 blocks incomplete text/source validation. Do not widen ownership to finish registration. No em/en dashes or spaced hyphen dash in authored output. Source quotations follow Q26's explicit verbatim exception.

Write the assigned tests first with their T28 ID and R/V/D/invariant trace. Property-test parsers/rules and use independently checked golden expected outcomes, not expected medical answers derived from the same config as input. Bound all iterations/pages/history/caches/external calls with published settings. Run every gate; missing prerequisites, zero collected scenarios, skip/xfail acceptance or missing positive path is not done. A done task has green owned gates, no unresolved enabled safety defect and evidence for every assigned trace. Epic done additionally requires the full suites, CI, independent review and coordinator-recorded AI-use rows. A failing gate is reported/fixed by its owner, never weakened. No product code is authorized outside the listed paths.

Build only E28-05, E28 6.2/6.4/7/8.4/8.5/9/10. Own features/plans including its component and Playwright tests; no ui/crew/e2e/, shell/router/offline/design edits. E03 owns shared scripts/client/router/slots/design and ui-copy; E15 owns episode/figure state; E05 owns capability gaps; E30 owns teaching/result; E31 roles; E16 preview; E20 shared cache/queue. P28-6/10 must supply actual callable hooks and configured words before acceptance. Use only Vue 3/strict TypeScript and generated @crew-health/contracts types/client per SYSTEM 6.3. No copied API type or hardcoded clinical/label/error text. This task owns no Python package, so pnpm strict types/lint replace Python mypy/ruff gates.

Create exact components from E28 7: AssessmentLayout.vue, GapCard.vue, PlanCard.vue, PlanDetail.vue, PlanRunView.vue, StepRow.vue. Layout places E13/E15 observed/explain through slots; keep Can't test here gap/form link and dashed ring from actual E05/E27/episode state. Do not build an assessment/diagnosis engine or modify E15's body map. PlanCard binds generated PlanView and open PlanRun from getConditionPlan/getPlan/listPlanRuns/startPlanRun/getPlanRun/actOnPlanRun, all six E28 operations in OpenAPI. Display PlanView.mode_text/tag_text/notice/stages and configured ground link_text/leaves_at; never infer link status or a plan from local defaults. Log for the ground navigates to E16's real preview route with authorized episode and accepted plan_run_id only after R28-5 lands.

GapCard's helper comes from the actual run's plan_step_role through GET /v1/plan-runs/{plan_run_id}/roles and role.proposed/role.changed, with reason_text/context_reasons, never choosing who_can[0]. Teach starts/reuses the subject's authorized open run with immutable key, obtains the proposal, and goes through E31's actual role acceptance flow. Launch startGuidedCheck with skill_id, helper_person_id, subject_person_id, plan_run_id and role_assignment_id as E28 7 and requests.schema.json GuidedCheckCreate specify. Await actual checked result through E30's component, preserve disagreement/manual/camera provenance, retry and what_it_shows. A successful count never closes E05's gap or states rhythm normal/excluded. No helper/model assignment shortcut. If no helper/provider, use configured unknown/unavailable and keep fixed help reachable.

PlanRunView and StepRow must render text/substitutes/availability/actions from the same pinned plan and run subject and current environment. R28-1's subject/plan_run_id parameters are not in base OpenAPI; never send them until centrally accepted/generated. Until then only own-subject matching-pin view can be executable when subject/pins are demonstrably identical; nonself/planning/mismatched pins show stored states with configured unknown text, help/close and printed guidance, no Done/Teach. Full requested multi-subject/pinned UI acceptance stays blocked until P28-6. Same-ID changed text, removed step and changed substitute after activation/restart must never combine active instructions with old state. Missing/rejected pin restricts to server allowed_actions; neither active version nor stale local who_can can re-enable it.

Render every required action control; missing R28-2 label uses designed_states.unknown with same accessible name but T28-34 fails until real configured labels exist. StepRow also suppresses completion when that particular step is non-executable, even if run.allowed_actions includes step_done for another step; a run-wide action array alone is not permission. Selecting a substitute leaves it open; Done targets its own eligible row. Rechecks show server due_text; no locally guessed countdown or interval. Preserve If-Match/key/body across retry; omit optional Config-Release on run actions while retaining run pins. Recognize only SYSTEM 5.8's fully validated accepted_command receipt as accepted late replay, never every DUPLICATE_COMMAND. Refetch stale/STEP_NOT_AVAILABLE/SUPPLY_BELOW_ZERO; do not claim saved state before acknowledgment.

Escalation opens E26's signed cached fixed flow synchronously before network, sign-in, disk, role/model or plan acceptance. In parallel request E28 escalate with original immutable identity. On failure keep help usable and use E26's documented normal entry/replay; never create two custom openers or infer parent acceptance from the help child. Show pending recording clearly using configured copy. D9 prohibits clinical run data in station; station still gets fixed help/public configuration/broadcast. Current authorization protects every response/event and owner-session memory. Event revision must strictly increase; stale/duplicate/late messages cannot repaint a newer run, wrong subject or signed-out screen. Reload after CURSOR_EXPIRED under the current grant.

SYSTEM 4.4 and E20 7.1/7.2 override the old E29 cache ownership. Consume E20 DocumentStore retention hooks only after P28-10; keep public pinned config/first-help text/version, never persist P2 PlanRun/subject/operator/stock/clinical completion views. Lock/sign-out/revocation clears clinical memory before another owner/station appears. Offline equipment/operator/stock eligibility is unknown and clinical actions disabled except help. If a command journal adapter is accepted, use E20 owner encryption/identity unchanged; do not implement queue crypto or persist free note text under a guessed policy. No cached P2 view reconstruction after browser restart.

Tests first within the owned features/plans directory: component tests plus Playwright .spec.ts suite selected by the final gate. T28-34 traces R50/D36/D39 and proves real ICL10 Assessment, complete labels, role reasons/acceptance/start payload, E30 result/ring, E16 navigation and keyboard focus. T28-35 traces V98 and invokes E21's actual scanner on feature sources and built bundle; missing scanner is not a no-content pass. T28-36 traces AGENTS 1: T5's scratch sourced text change renders with same bundle; invalid candidate retains last good, no mapping edit. T28-37 traces V97: warm verified E20 public cache, stop hub, then show versioned steps and fixed help without auth/storage, within charter 500 ms budget for help; browser restart/owner switch exposes no P2 state. Include loading/empty/error/stale/offline/SIM/REPLAY/unavailable, origin/review labels, pin change/restart, absent/incapacitated subject, missing helper/E30/model/device/link, concurrent viewer update and late callback after lock. D32 additionally compares rendered kit/plan/result counts to T5's same frozen server count; coordinate actual E03/E27/E21 components rather than copying them.

Real-browser tests launch the actual shell/hub composition via the E21/E03 harness and temporary real SQLite, with no page.route responses, mock API client, store replacement or hub dependency override. Use explicit demo profile and source-derived fixtures. Optional external adapters may be absent/documented fakes, internal hub logic stays real. If the E31/E30/E16/Assessment view, UI hooks, Playwright scripts or D32 counterpart aren't built, report that positive acceptance blocked; don't replace with isolated rendered literals. Use ordered lists/headings, configured accessible button names, text states and aria-live for another person's updates, keyboard help from every screen. No clinical claims beyond checks performed.

Done requires all four pnpm gates, full T28-34 to 37 and D32 browser evidence without skipped acceptance, and accepted R28-1/2 seams for the complete runnable view. T5 owns API/fault/printed-backup proofs; consume its fixture/release contract, don't reimplement them. Full UI suite reruns after fixes; return shared hooks/copy defects to their owners.
gates: pnpm -C ui/crew lint
pnpm -C ui/crew typecheck
pnpm -C ui/crew test
pnpm -C ui/crew exec playwright test src/features/plans
